terms.comment: Not a classical word: it is the species name of the robin (Erithacus rubecula); the vowels are left unmarked. Lewis & Short thinks the classical fringilla was perhaps the robin, perhaps the chaffinch.

terms.gloss: a small bird, perhaps the robin, perhaps the chaffinch

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
